title: Three-Payment Settlement: Raises for Missed Payment Arrangement Installments
content:
# Three-Payment Settlement — Missed-Installment Raises

The installment history of the consumer's Payment Arrangements on an account bears on the price of a Three-Payment Settlement offer on that account under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements.

**Rule.** Where the consumer's payment plans on the account record three or more missed installments, the Three-Payment broken-promise raise of 4.0 points applies; where they record one or two missed installments, the Three-Payment missed-installment raise of 2.0 points applies; an account whose plans record no missed installment carries no raise.

A raise adds percentage points in pricing the Three-Payment offer. The count takes the missed installments recorded on every payment plan the consumer has had on that account.

## Ladder

| Missed installments recorded on the account's plans | Raise |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | broken-promise raise, 4.0 percentage points |
| 1 or 2 | missed-installment raise, 2.0 percentage points |
| 0, or no plan on the account | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- One plan with two missed installments and a later plan with one missed installment: three missed installments in all, so the broken-promise raise of 4.0 points.
- A single plan recording one missed installment: the missed-installment raise of 2.0 points.
- A plan with every installment paid: no raise.
